title: Epichaperomes: redefining chaperone biology and therapeutic strategies in complex diseases
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,678-698
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00010F, Review Article

Chiranjeevi Pasala, Chander S. Digwal, Sahil Sharma, Shujuan Wang, Alessia Bubula, Gabriela Chiosis
Aberrant phosphorylation drives epichaperome formation, transforming chaperones into scaffolding platforms that rewire PPI networks. Epichaperome disruptors normalize PPI networks, enabling a paradigm shift toward network-centric disease treatment.
